profile.headline: Software Engineer at Broadcom
profile.summary:
A software Engineer with extensive development experiences with solid background on system software and hardware. 

Specialties: C/C++, virtualization, docker, Linux, JAVA, Python, Bash, Compiler, Embedded System, HW/SW Codesign, Virtual Prototypes, GNU tools, Go

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Palo Alto, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
vSphere control plane (vpxd) — orchestration of group hot migration
•   Developed and hardened vpxd coordination for group disk-only migration of VMs sharing multiwriter disks, extending legacy per-VM workflows to execute concurrently.
•   Designed synchronization and group lifecycle handling for concurrent migration workflows, including gather/broadcast exchange, barrier coordination, cancellation, exception propagation, and cleanup paths to prevent workflows from hanging when individual participants fail or exit early.
•   Diagnosed and fixed concurrency and lifecycle failures across vpxd and VMX migration paths, including deadlocks from abandoned barriers, unsafe recursive cancellation, and semaphore use-before-initialization/use-after-destruction caused by concurrent migration cleanup and signaling.
•   Identified fundamental limitations in the team’s C++ unit-test infrastructure that impeded modern C++ development; drove the team away from new source-transformation-based UUT tests and introduced dependency-injection patterns with working examples to improve native testability.
•    Mentored engineers on synchronization design and regularly led C++ code reviews for concurrency-sensitive changes and performance

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Jose, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Android device virtualization on macOS and Linux hosts
•   Designed and prototyped Vulkan graphics API remoting to forward guest Vulkan calls to the host GPU; produced the design and proof of concept and improved launcher-app rendering performance by approximately 10 FPS by internal measurement
•   Sole developer and maintainer of the CoreAudio backend for the virtual Android device, spanning the guest audio HAL, QEMU, CoreAudio, AudioToolbox, and custom synchronization layers; implemented headset hot-plug support and owned debugging and maintenance of the subsystem.
•   Diagnosed and fixed difficult multithreaded and timing-sensitive audio failures, including synchronization and object-lifetime races that reproduced only intermittently across hundreds of runs.
•   Improved the team’s code-review and verification practices by introducing automated validation tooling and performing deep reviews of large systems changes.
•   Mentored junior engineers on linking/loading semantics (RenderDoc + virtual device), spinlock vs. blocking I/O tradeoffs, and Vulkan debug extensions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Android Virtualization for Google Cloud
 * Open sources 
  - https://cs.android.com/android/platform/superproject/+/master:device/google/cuttlefish/
  - https://github.com/google/android-cuttlefish
 * Cuttlefish Confirmation UI
   - Confirmation UI virtualization
      + Virtualization of the guest HAL service that cooperates with (virtual) Trusted Execution Environment
      + Technical challenges
           * E.g. Differences in context switch between virtual and physical devices
               The HAL in physical devices effectively calls a device driver, and the kernel does not preempt it.
               The HAL in virtual devices waits for virtio-console read/write, and the kernel can preempt it
               Cuttlefish has a guest inside hypervisor and a set of cooperating host services  
Cvd Server/Client
  - A custom server that selects, starts, monitors, and controls different sets of Cuttlefish builds, each has a different set of host services and the guest
  - Took over from the initial author, serves as the second primary developer for the cvd server and client
  - Refactored and extended features (e.g. Reset, etc)
  - Technical challenges
      * E.g. Complicated process controls by a multi-threaded application
      * E.g. Self-updating server driven by the client
  - Impacts
     + Used by the current and next generations acloud for every "creation" of devices
         Acloud is used by virtually every Android developer within the organization
Cvd Device Selector
   - Served as the sole developer
   - Technical challenges
      + E.g. Supporting a broad range of builds minimizing the backport
Dockerization for Cuttlefish
  * Implemented docker containers for the partners who use non-gLinux OS
      +  contributions outside cuttlefish is found here:
           https://github.com/google/android-cuttlefish
      + implemented cuttlefish features to allow or extend the support of dockerization

positions.title: Member of Techincal Staff
positions.description:
Linux Toolchain Development
 * The team delivers toolchains for Oracle Linux in forms of RPMs, VMs such as cloud image, etc
 * Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Developer image
   - Maintaining java and go OCI SDK RPMs
   - Optimized image build process 
       + build time: 1/3
       + automated
       + input data made concise:  63 lines vs. 163 lines per image
   - Implemented and/or improved spec files of multiple RPMs
   - Provided system-wide configurations for the image
 * Golang maintainer for x86 and arm64
    - Identifying/fixing Oracle Specific bugs
 * Docker build with gccgo
    - Patched docker source to build with gccgo
 * Occasional debugging GNU tools
 * Auto FDO

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
IR-level optimization (IROPT)
   * Auto vectorization for x86 
   * Auto vectorization for sparc
   * Memory optimization 
      - E.g. array remapping
   * Scalar optimization 
      - E.g. conditional expression elimination
   * IR simulator generator
      - Debuggable and executable IR-level simulation model from the given IRs
      - Sole implementator for this on-going project

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistance
positions.description:
• Embedded System Environment (ESE, www.cecs.uci.edu/~ese)
  - Research focus: system specification and architecture exploration to optimize performance and power consumption
  - Developed a CAD toolset, ESE (over 150K LOC in C++), to model and validate multi-processor embedded systems
  - ESE attracted considerable interest from corporate giants including Toyota, Lockheed-Martin, and Bosch

• Modeling Multimedia Applications
 - Modeling MP3 and JPEG decoders in Program State Machines, which is executable

• Lab Servers Administration
  Gentoo and Redhat Linux Server Configuration and Administration. Services include NIS, NFS, SMB, Subversion, HTTP, HTTPS, Mail, etc

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistance
positions.description:
• ASIP for H.264 On-chip Encoder
    - Architected and implemented an Application-Specific Instruction-set Processor (ASIP) for H.264 on-chip encoder
    - The ASIP was delivered to a start-up company and successfully commercialized.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
• Java Compiler Optimization
    - Implemented back-end optimization modules for an ahead-of-time Java compiler for ARM7
• RF-sensor Based Health Care System
    - Designed and developed sensor control server and its GUI using Java
• NES Emulator on WIPI
    - Ported a PC-based NES emulator to WIPI, a standard platform for mobile handheld appliances in Korea
• Linux Server Administration
    - Administrated Linux servers (Gentoo, Debian, Redhat) for SAMBA, NFS, NIS, Mail, SFTP, Web services, and so on

positions.title: Undergraduate Student
positions.description:
• 16 bit RISC Processor and Simulator
- Developed 16 bit RISC Processor in both SystemC and VHDL
- Developed a simulator for the same processor in JAVA

• Cracking x86 Binary Files
- cracked binary files w/ GNU tools

• RTOS/Device Driver
- Implemented RTOS context switch, Linux device driver for RTC clock

positions.title: Co-Op
positions.description:
• Re-targetable Source Level Debugger for Reconfigurable Processors
    - Served as a technical leader for debugger engine development team throughout the project
    - Developed a full-featured re-targetable debugger for Samsung’s reconfigurable processor
    - Collaborated with several teams in SAIT and successfully lead the project
